title: Steer and validate tenant migrations during geo-failures (weighted attenuation protocol)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem statement: during several multi-tenant, cross-region degradations we've observed two failure modes: (1) sudden routing blackholes when control-plane KV snapshots fall behind causing batches to be routed to unhealthy compute, and (2) noisy tenant evictions when full rehome floods cold pools and triggers client-visible tail latency spikes. This ticket creates a prescriptive operational runbook and lightweight automation to perform a 'weighted attenuation' migration: a gradual, observable steering of tenant traffic away from a degraded region into warm standby targets with validation gating per-tenant. The goal is to avoid mass cold-starts and reduce customer impact while keeping ops steps simple and reversible.
comments: 2025-11-04 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket after postmortem review of INC-2025-11-01. Initial draft of steps and validation criteria added to Confluence. Noted that warm-standby capacity reservation is required for Dedicated customers.

2025-11-05 - Marcus Liu: Spike completed to prototype 'attenuation-controller' that can apply per-tenant weights and enforce a max ramp rate. Prototype can change weights via the routing API and patch a tenant's assigned pool. Added unit tests for ramp logic. PR opened: #4183.

2025-11-07 - Priya Nair (SRE): Ran tabletop exercise with on-call rota. Observed that KV resync detection currently relies on 1m sampling; proposing to add a fast-check path that queries last-applied index for the tenant namespace before initiating ramp.

2025-11-08 - Marcus Liu: Updated runbook with explicit abort criteria: >15% 95th tail increase on downstream request latency for a tenant within 10 minutes of a weight change OR >3% increase in error rate. Added automated rollback to previous weight with a circuit-breaker cooldown of 5m.

2025-11-09 - Design review by Elena Gomez: UX for console stepper included — operator can preview per-tenant expected traffic shift, estimated additional tokens/sec, and expected cold-start CPU. Requested clearer color-coding for 'validation status' (green/yellow/red).

2025-11-10 - Marcus Liu: Integrated telemetry hooks. New metrics emitted: tenant_attn_weight, tenant_attn_ramp_rate, tenant_attn_validations_passed. Added Grafana dashboard panel and alert rule: AttenuationValidationFailures > 0 for 3m -> page SRE.

2025-11-11 - Customer success (Jordan Reed): Coordinated pre-notice messages for three high-value Dedicated customers and scheduled dry-run for 2025-11-16 during low-traffic window. Customers requested a one-hour rollback SLA in case of degradation.

2025-11-12 - QA (Sofia Martinez): Completed integration test run in staging with synthetic tenants. Observed a ~7% P95 improvement for victims with ramp rate 10%/min. Found a flaky path where rare (0.2%) handshake timeouts cause the controller to misclassify validation as failed; mitigation added to tolerate up to 2 consecutive micro-failures before abort.
Next steps: finalize automation tuning, complete docs and runbook drills, schedule Dedicated customer dry-run, merge PR and deploy to canary for hosted control plane.
